name: Disaster Blaster
main_effect: [Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. If you have a Digimon in play with 2 or more colors, or with 2 or more colors in its digivolution cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP instead.
